{{Top|leg}}
The '''''Naboo Herald''''' was a news publication published on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] [[Ista Kezever]] published the article "Galaxy in Review ... Intergalactic Report 12.1" about changes in politics and technology in the in the ''Naboo Herald''.<ref>{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Loading Screen: "Publish 12.1"}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
When the developers of the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']] released the Publish 12.1 update in January 2005,<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> a loading screen styled as a news article written by "Ista Kezever reporting for the ''Naboo Herald''" was shown to all players of the game, describing various changes to the game in an [[in-universe]] style.
